# Fixture patterns: the configured team key and owner, and the licensor.
\b{{team}}-[0-9]+\b
(?i){{owner}}
(?i){{licensor}}
# The project's own address may be named.
!(?i)^readme\.md:.*example\.com/{{owner}}/widget
# The configuration names the owner, which is what it is for.
!^\.config/jig\.yaml:.*
# The copyright line names the licensor by definition.
!^NOTICE:Copyright [0-9]{4} {{licensor}}$
